overview: A private two-person chat app where friends pair with a connection code and share text, photos, audio, music, and files.
features: Sign in and set up a display name and avatar
Create a shareable connection code to pair with a friend
Join a friend's conversation by entering their code
Send and receive text messages in a shared conversation
Share photos, audio, music, and documents with inline previews and players
Polished light and dark theme with responsive layout
